injuries.description: minor head injury / concussion with persistent postconcussional syndrome
source: This gentleman was assaulted by people using mobile phone hitting over the head on 2 October 2001.
Professor Poon concluded that Mr. Hung had a minor head injury on 2 October 2001.
Mr. Hung also suffered from persistent postconcussional syndrome with headache and dizziness that require regular medication

injuries.description: gross deficit of muscle group of left upper limb with motor power grade 2/5
source: Upon examination, doctors found the muscle group on his left upper limb to be grossly deficit with grade 2/5 which meant his motor power was not sufficient for anti-gravity activities.
